title: ProMedical: Hierarchical Fine-Grained Criteria Modeling for Medical LLM Alignment via Explicit Injection

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing reward preferences between verbose and concise model responses to demonstrate that the framework prioritizes structural logic and clinical accuracy over text volume.

Assessing the model's ability to reject unsafe, hallucinated, or out-of-scope medical advice that is presented with a confident, empathetic, or highly authoritative tone using a lexicographical safety veto.
